Builds the DD/DG/GG/DM/GM hourglass stiffness scalings from the IKT material-tangent buffer; callers are the same seven unported implicit *ke2/*cke3 routines. No port routine builds a DD/DG/DM/GM block for this element. Upstream engine/source/elements/solid/solide8z/mmstifs.F is reached only from ../engine/source/elements/solid_2d/quad4/q4ke2.F, ../engine/source/elements/solid/solide10/s10ke3.F, ../engine/source/elements/solid/solide20/s20ke3.F, ../engine/source/elements/solid/solide4/s4ke3.F (and 3 more); no caller of that list is a path this port runs.

Rotates CC and G3 into the (CC, CG, G33) triple through CBATRAN3; its only caller is mmats.F. solid_orthotropic.mstiforthv is a different routine from a different file (mstiforthv.F) and must not be credited here.

MIN/MAX-accumulates the element time step into KTBUF_STR(NG_IMP)%ETFAC (the /IMPL/NONLIN etfac); callers are cmain3.F, mmain.F90 and mmain8.F. The port has no ETFAC store and no implicit convergence buffer at all.

Stores A_KT and the normalized deviatoric stress SIGE(1..6) into KTBUF_STR(KTBUFEP) for the implicit radial return; its only caller is mmain.F90. The port's forces() keeps sig in group.state and never writes a SIGE/A_KT buffer.

Rotates the 36 element stiffness 3x3 blocks K11..K88 from the corotational frame Q(R11..R33) back into global coordinates; callers are s8zke3.F (this family's implicit tangent, unported) and the thickshell s8cke3.F. The port rotates the internal FORCE by R in forces() but never assembles or rotates a stiffness for this element.

the velocity-gradient Dxx..Dzz plus the ICP==1 assumed-volumetric-dilatation DVCA term are reproduced with the same formulation. Absent: the ICP/=1 B-matrix branch, the ICR/ICS/ICT constant-stress branches, the JCVT/ISCAU non-linear correction and the DSV volume-update bookkeeping.

Its defining job is the ICP==1 volumetric scaling JFAC = EXP((2/3)*NU*LOG(DET0/DET)) applied to Dxx..Dzz through JACOB_J33; upstream reaches it only inside the block s8zforc3.F:592 `IF (ISMSTR >= 10 .AND. ISMSTR <= 12)`. solid_hexa8z.forces has no ISMSTR flag, no DET0/NU/JFAC term, and its Dxx..Dzz are used raw to build deps.

the centroid Jacobian, determinant, volume and dN/dx are computed by cofactor inversion of the same trilinear derivative set. Absent: the per-node PX..PZY assumed-strain gradients, the ICP/=1 and ICP==11 BXY/BYX/BXZ/BZX/BYZ/BZY matrices, PXC/PYC/PZC and DELTAX/SMAX.

The NDVCA contraction is evaluated (sum over the first four nodes of dndx*d v_loc) but the result is assigned to trD, which feeds ONLY the bulk-viscosity pressure and dt_crit — it never replaces Dxx..Dzz in deps, so the assumed volumetric dilatation does not reach the constitutive update. The contraction also uses the single centroid dndx from _geometry instead of the per-node assumed-strain PX1..PZ4, and the X17/X28/X35/X46 diagonals, HX/HY/HZ hourglass vectors, IDEG/JLAG branches and the SCHKJABT3 negative-Jacobian stop are absent.

The negative-volume repair: upstream reaches it only at s8zforc3.F:865 `IF (NNEGA > 0)`, i.e. when at least one Gauss point came back with VOL <= 0. solid_hexa8z._geometry instead clamps detJ <= EM20 to a zero gradient and logs, and never maintains NNEGA/INDEX, so this repair is unreached.

Reached only from s8zforc3.F:593 `IF (ISMSTR == 11)` — the total-strain-rate (small-strain / Ismstr=11) derivative set on the X0/Y0/Z0 geometry. solid_hexa8z.forces has no ISMSTR flag and no separate small-strain kinematics, so this branch is unreached.

The ELSE (ISMSTR 10 or 12) sibling of S8ZDERICT3, still inside the s8zforc3.F:592 `ISMSTR >= 10 .AND. ISMSTR <= 12` block, and it is the variant that also writes GBUF%JAC_I. solid_hexa8z has neither ISMSTR nor a JAC_I buffer, so the branch is unreached.
The inverse-Jacobian derivative set used only to build the implicit element stiffness; its sole caller is s8zke3.F. The port has no tangent() for this element, so the routine is unreached.

The port forms L_ab = sum_i ve_loc[i,a]*dndx[i,b] with the single centroid-Jacobian dndx from _geometry — a one-point, non-assumed-strain B — where S8ZDERIM3 builds the full per-node PXY/PYX/PXZ/PZX/PYZ/PZY assumed-strain B over the Gauss loop. MEASURED PARITY CONSEQUENCE: none — no parity case exists (SOLID_ISOLID_GROUPS has no Isolid key 14, so nothing routes to "bricks_hexa8z"; parity_m36.json lists RD_V_0240/Modele_HEXA_P14_Isolid24 as PYRADIOSS-FAIL). Follow-up task P2.14: build a /BRICK Isolid=14 corpus case and quantify the volumetric-locking error against upstream before calling this acceptable.

Recomputes the Jacobian and its inverse in double precision for the negative-volume elements only; upstream reaches it at s8zforc3.F:897 inside the `IF (NNEGA > 0)` block (inside S8ZDERICM3). The port has no NNEGA/INDEX machinery and no double-precision VOLDP store, so it is unreached.

_geometry covers only the plain per-element part: the Jacobian built from CJ1..CJ9, its cofactor inverse and the volume. Absent are the HX/HY/HZ hourglass-vector contributions to JAC1..JAC9, the Gauss-point loop with A_GAUSS/WI, the double-precision VOLDP bookkeeping, and the NNEGA negative-volume detection with its /NEGVOL/STOP and MSTOP ANCMSG error path.

Reached only at s8zforc3.F:695, inside the `IF (ISMSTR >= 10 .AND. ISMSTR <= 12)` block, and driven by the JACOB_F0 centroid gradients PXC/PYC/PZC with the A_GAUSS(IR,NPTR) weights. solid_hexa8z.forces has no ISMSTR and no PXC/PYC/PZC/A_GAUSS equivalent, so the routine is unreached.

same output (nodal internal forces from sigma and gradN, rotated back by R) but the volumetric-stress treatment differs: the port subtracts only QVIS from the three normal components, whereas upstream's ICP==1 general branch removes a third of the stress trace and scales by JFAC*VOL. The ICP/=1 B-matrix force terms and the SVIS/thermal/plastic-work averages are absent. Parity has NOT been measured: no validation case is tied to s8zfint3 or to this element group.

The non-local (INLOC/NLOC_DMG) regularized internal force over the 8 Gauss points, reached from s8zforc3.F:1361 inside `IF (INLOC > 0)`. No pyradioss module implements non-local damage for this element — solid_hexa8z.forces has no INLOC/NLOC_DMG/VAR_REG input and no nlocal_reg equivalent — so it is unreached.

Adds the ICP==1 volumetric 'pressure pair' force PP*VOL*(PX,PY,PZ) to the four opposite node pairs, gated at s8zforc3.F:1441 on `ICP == 1 .AND. ISMSTR /= 10 .AND. ISMSTR /= 12`. The port computes no volumetric pressure PP (its S goes straight from sig to f = -vol*gradN . S) and has no ICP flag, so it is unreached.

forces() runs the explicit corotational cycle (frame, kinematics, material law, hourglass, stress rotation, energy, critical dt, force scatter) but only the default path: no degenerate-element handling, no small-strain/ISPIN variants, no thermal, no sensor or element-failure bookkeeping and no per-cycle state save.

The complete corotational element-stiffness assembly (SRCOORK frame, MMATS/MMSTIFS, S8ZDERII3, S8ZLKE3/S8ZLKEP3, S8ZKGEI3/S8ZKGEO3, S8ZCUMG3, ASSEM_S8). The port's solid_hexa8z exposes only init_group and forces, and pyradioss/implicit/assembly.py:67 raises NotImplementedError('element group has no implicit tangent()') for it — an /IMPL/NONLIN run with a /BRICK Isolid=14 part cannot be served. Upstream engine/source/elements/solid/solide8z/s8zke3.F is reached only from ../engine/source/implicit/imp_glob_k.F, ../engine/source/implicit/imp_glob_k.F; no caller of that list is a path this port runs.

Assembles the DD (material) x hourglass-B 3x3 block KIJ for the element stiffness; its callers are s8zlke3.F (this family's unported implicit tangent) and the thickshell s6clke3.F. The port has no hourglass stiffness block for this element.

Its only callers are s4cumg3.F, s10cumg3.F and s20cumg3.F — the implicit assembly routines of the tetra4, tetra10 and tetra20 families. The port's solid_tetra4.tangent and solid_bric20.tangent are their own derivations, not ports of s4ke3/s20ke3, so S8ZKEBG1 is never called anywhere in pyradioss.
The DG (dilatation gradient) x hourglass-B stiffness block, reachable only from s8zlke3.F — this family's implicit tangent, which the port does not implement.
Accumulates the DD (diagonal B) material-stiffness block KIJ; callers are s8zlke3.F, s8zlkep3.F and the unported s4cumg3/s10cumg3/s20cumg3. The port has no element stiffness for this family.

Accumulates the isotropic hourglass stiffness block G*sum(PXY*PXY + PXZ*PXZ); callers are s8zlke3.F and the unported s4cumg3/s10cumg3/s20cumg3. solid_hexa8z.forces builds an hourglass FORCE (gamma . qdot) but never the matching G stiffness block.

The orthotropic G33 hourglass stiffness block (BI*G33*BJ); callers are s8zlke3.F and the unported s4cumg3/s10cumg3/s20cumg3. solid_hexa8z.forces uses a single isotropic hourglass coefficient hcoef — there is no G33 matrix anywhere in the module.

HIJ = F:(P_i (x) P_j) helper for the geometric stiffness; its callers are s8zkgeo3.F (this family's unported implicit tangent) and s4keh3.F in the tetra family. No port routine forms this contraction.
The 3x3 sibling of S8ZKEH3 (writes KIJ(J,J) += HIJ instead of returning HIJ); its only caller is s8zkgei3.F, itself reached solely from the unported s8zke3.F and the thickshell s8cke3.F.

The corotational-frame geometric (initial-stress) stiffness F*VOL . gradN gradN over all 8 nodes; callers are s8zke3.F and the thickshell s8cke3.F. The port has no kgeo() for this element — pyradioss/implicit/assembly.py:73-75 would call kernel.kgeo and cannot.

The 4-node geometric stiffness with hourglass cross-terms (K11/K17/K77 ...), called only from the unported s8zke3.F and the thickshell s8cke3.F. No port routine assembles this 36-block element geometric stiffness for solid_hexa8z.

Builds the full local stiffness K11..K88 from DD/GG/DG/G33 including the hourglass blocks; its only callers are s8zke3.F (unported implicit tangent for this family) and the thickshell s8cke3.F. The 628-line core of the element's implicit behaviour has no counterpart in pyradioss.
The ICP volumetric-pressure stiffness block (HH/VOL/FAC -> DD -> K via S8ZKED3), reached only from the unported s8zke3.F and s8cke3.F; the port never forms PP or its stiffness.

Computes the ICP==2 plastic-work fraction FAC = DEFP/(sqrt(SIGY)/E0 + DEFP) that shifts NU before the volumetric correction. Upstream reaches it from s8zforc3.F:933 `IF (ICP == 2)`; solid_hexa8z.forces has no ICP branch at all (no ICP==1 JFAC path either) and never asks the constitutive law for a plastic-work return, so it is unreached.

Interpolates the 8 nodal temperatures to the element centroid (TEMPEL = sum NI_k*TEMP(NCk)) for the S8Z thermal strain; upstream reaches it from s8zforc3.F:1186 `IF (JTHE < 0)`. solid_hexa8z.forces has no JTHE, no TEMP and no thermal term. solid_thermal.forces is NOT this routine — it is the mmain.F90:778 fully-constrained group thermal path on solid_hexa8._geometry.

The deleted-element half is covered: forces() masks fe_glob with np.where(alive[:,None,None], fe_glob, 0.0) before scattering, which is the F11..F38 zeroing. The state-buffer half is not: there is no once-per-cycle reset of SIGM/EINTM/RHOM/QM/STIN/PP/EINTTHM/DEFPM/EPSDM/CONDEN, and the port has no PP (volumetric pressure), no STIN (initial-stress) and no per-cycle CONDEN term at all — it simply overwrites sig/eint each cycle.

IKT==4 branch of MMSTIFS: builds the hourglass stiffness (DD, CG, G33) from the implicit buffer's normalized deviatoric stress SIGE and radial-return alpha A_KT. Its only caller is mmstifs.F, which exists only for the unported implicit stiffness of this family; the port has no SIGE/A_KT store to read.

IKT==3 branch of MMSTIFS: the von-Mises hourglass derivative DD1/GT/HT built from SIG and the implicit A_KT factor HT. Its only caller is mmstifs.F; the port has no A_KT buffer, and its single isotropic hourglass coefficient (hcoef in forces()) is not derived from the deviatoric stress this routine needs.

The rank-one deviatoric correction DD -= s.s, GT -= st.st applied by SKTCONS2 (IKT==4); its only caller is sktcons2.F, which itself exists only inside MMSTIFS for the unported implicit stiffness of this family. The chain is unreached from any ported routine.

Re-orthogonalizes the material GAMA directions into the global frame after the sortho3 iteration; srcoork.F:219-220 calls it only under `ISORTH > 0 .AND. KHBE == 17`. solid_hexa8z has neither an ISORTH nor a KHBE flag and _corotational_frame never touches GAMA, so the routine is unreached.

The srepisot3 + sortho3 core (the R11..R33 orthonormal frame, including the KHBE==17/24 argument swap) is transcribed; the SRCOORK job around it is not. Missing: the X/V gather and projection into the frame beyond the plain einsum in forces(), the NGL/MXT integration bookkeeping, the 36 K11..K88 blocks built in the frame, the GAMA/GAMA0 hourglass vectors, the IREP/IGTYP/ISORTH/JCVT branches, and the REMESH path. Both upstream callers (s8zke3.F, s8cke3.F) are unported.

The 3x3 similarity transform K <- Q K Q^T used by S8ZCUMG3 to rotate element stiffness blocks out of the corotational frame; its callers are s8zcumg3.F and the thickshell s6ccumg3.F, both implicit-assembly routines the port does not implement. solid_orthotropic.cbatran3v ports cbatran3v.F of the szforc3 family, not SYSTRAN3, and must not be credited here.

No counterpart in pyradioss: C33STIF2EL is reachable only from mmodul.F's MTN==24 branch (PM(50), PM(53..55) armature), and solid_orthotropic.mmodul (solid_orthotropic.py:687-712) omits MTN 24 entirely, so the routine is unreachable in the port.

Body implements K(I,J) = sum_pq VQI(p,I) KK(p,q) VQJ(q,J) with the transpose on the LEFT, and reproduces the ISYM==1 upper-triangle-only write (out = kk.copy() with only the strict/upper triangle replaced) exactly as the Fortran leaves the lower triangle untouched.
E1/E2/E3 = GAMA(:,1:3)/GAMA(:,4:6)/E1xE2 and the four cosine products QC/QGC/QG/QCG are transcribed index for index, including the Fortran's cyclic K = J+1 (3 -> 1) via nxt = [1,2,0].

The CC/CG/G33 -> NFHOUR orthotropic hourglass stress has no counterpart in pyradioss; it is reached upstream only from szhour3_or.F, which the port explicitly declares absent (solid_orthotropic.py:57-59 names szhour3_or.F, szsvm_or.F and gfhour_or.F as not transcribed).

Only caller is materials/mat/mat001/m1lawtot.F, and m1lawtot itself is not ported: pyradioss/materials/law01_elastic.py transcribes sigeps01.F only and contains neither m1lawtot nor this MAT001 stabilisation, so the routine is unreached in the port.

The Isolid=24 (HEPH) damaged-element moduli have no counterpart; MDAMA24 is called only from szhour3.F / szhour3_or.F / s6zhourg3.F90, none of which is ported, and pyradioss has no HEPH element at all (solid_hexa8.py:617 records that gap explicitly).
Body divides CC, G33 and CG by GG, mirroring the strict-lower triangle exactly as the Fortran's DO K=J,3 then CC(I,K,J)=CC(I,J,K) does; CG is divided over all nine entries as upstream.

Every MTN branch is transcribed (12/14, 25/107/112 Poisson, 28/68/50/53/93/122/123/125/127/130 diagonal, 128 bulk/shear, and the ELSE 3E/(1+nu) form with G33(J,J)=GG/2 and CG=0) except MTN==24, the reinforced branch that blends PM(50)/PM(53..55) through C33STIF2EL — an Isolid=24 HEPH path the port has no element for.

The damage-modified Hook matrix DE1..DE6/DEN of the Isolid=24 HEPH concrete has no counterpart; its only caller is mdama24.F, itself unreached (see row mdama24.F), and the module states outright that mmodul24c.F belongs to solid_heph and none of it appears in this kernel.

All three sandwiches are reproduced with the right ISYM and weights: CG = HALF*QC.CC.QCG + 2*QGC.G.QG (ISYM=0), G33 = FOURTH*QCG.CC.QCG + QG.G.QG, CC = QC.CC.QC + 4*QGC.G.QGC (both ISYM=1, the Fortran never resetting ISYM), then the closing mirror of CC and G33.

The MAT001 non-linear-viscosity stress addition CNS2/CNS3 is not ported: its only caller is materials/mat/mat001/m1lawtot.F, which does not exist in pyradioss (law01_elastic.py carries sigeps01.F only), so the routine is unreached.
Body is exactly the coordinate split the Fortran performs - X0(I,1..8)/Y0/Z0 into the 24 single-node columns - returned in the Fortran's own order X1..X8, Y1..Y8, Z1..Z8; no rotation, no strain rate.

Upstream is DELTAX = 128*min(VLINC(1..8))/sqrt(SMAX) with HUNDRED28=128 (constant_mod.F:619) - a MINIMUM over the eight sub-block volumes, which equals V/8 only for a regular hexa - and its SDLEN_DEGE branch for IDTS6>0. The port computes the coarser lc = V/max(face area) from the exact volume, so on a distorted or degenerate hexa the element time step differs from upstream's; the parity consequence of that difference has NOT been measured - follow-up task P2.14.

The solid/multi-surface (self-contact, TAGPRT_SMS) characteristic length is not ported; szforc3.F calls it only for SMS parts and pyradioss has no self-contact solid element, so it is unreached in the port.

The SELECT CASE (MTN) coefficient ladder is transcribed branch for branch (cases 70, 42/69, 62, 88, 90, the default arm, the law-1/62 hourglass-strain stiffening and the IF (ISCTL==0) F_ET=ONE reset), but the routine's own control body is not: shour_ctl's FCL = FVL*rho*c*ll*ll viscous coefficient and its FHOUR/force block are served by s_hg5.F's transcription in solid_hourglass5.apply, which uses the different FCL = F_ET*CAQ*vol**(1/3).

The rotation is implemented but the engineering-shear rescale is not: SORDEF12 halves D4/D5/D6 into tensor shear before SROTO12 and doubles them back afterwards, while solid_orthotropic.szordef3 is a plain alias of sroto3, so a strain increment stored as gamma_xy leaves with its shear components 2x too large unless the caller pre-halves them.

SORDEFT12's operator is F_ab = sum_cd R_ac M_cd R_bd on the nine MXX..MZZ components, which is exactly what sordeft3 computes (R M R^T with the frame rows) on the same nine values held as a 3x3 tensor; the only difference is the Fortran's separate-array layout.

Verified term for term: SORDEFT3's SX/SY/SZ/FXX block is F = R M R^T with R's ROWS the material directions, which is what np.einsum(r, m, r.swapaxes) evaluates; the cycle calls it after converting the engineering-Voigt rate to a tensor strain (_voigt_to_tensor), which is the correct reading of MFXX..MFZZ.

The 6-component stress rotation is present but applied as the INVERSE R^T sigma R, not the Fortran's R sigma R^T; this is a deliberate documented port decision (the port rotates the stress itself rather than leaving it to MMAIN) and the Fortran's exact form is not available from any symbol.
Byte-identical body to sroto12.F apart from the NEL argument; the port's sroto3 carries the same core but as the inverse R^T sigma R, so the upstream direction is not reproduced.

sroto3.F writes SIGN_ab = sum_cd R_ac SIG_cd R_bd (R sigma R^T); the port deliberately applies the inverse R^T sigma R, as stated in its own docstring and pinned by the test suite. The consequence is confined to the sign of the frame: for an isotropic material the two agree, for an anisotropic one the rotated moduli come out transposed.

The vectorised SROTO3 core over the 6-component stress Voigt is what solid_orthotropic.sroto3 computes, but the port has no separate write-to-SIGN entry point and applies the inverse rotation; the shear HALF/TWO that SROTO3V's caller SZORDEF3 applies is likewise absent here.

G1 = GAMA(:,1:3), G2 = GAMA(:,4:6), G3 = G1 x G2 as the frame ROWS, with the identity frame supplied by material_frame when iorth == 0 - the same pair of branches STORTH3 selects. The gate is written `orthtrop > 0` rather than the Fortran's `ISORTH == 1`, which coincides for the 0/1 values the starter writes.

The arithmetic is verbatim (pxx..pyz, aa, bb, p, d, DELTAX1 = 1/sqrt(d), and the gfac >= 1 -> exactly zero branch), but the only port caller, dt_claim, feeds it the eight shape-function gradients dndx[:,:,k] where szforc3.F:615-618 passes SZDERITO3's four sub-block gradients PX1..PX4 - so DELTAX1, and hence the orthotropic element time step, is computed from a different B-matrix than upstream's. Not measured against the oracle.

DET and the cartesian shape gradients of the hex-8 by centroid cofactor expansion; the SZDERI3 hourglass PXaHi products, the SCHKJABT3 negative-Jacobian rescue and the SZDERIT3/SZDERITO3 orientation variants have no counterpart.
The IKT/MTN viscous-limiting ladder that rescales G(I) by FAC is not ported; its only callers are szhour3.F, szhour3_or.F and s6zhourg3.F90, none of which exists in pyradioss, so it is unreached.

The cycle is a reduced szforc3: geometry/lumping from solid_hexa8, Jaumann rotation of the old stress, the material-frame rate (sordeft3) and its inverse on the stress, sfint3 force assembly, the energy ledger and the dt claim are all present, but the ALE/JCVT paths (SZTORTH3, STORTH3, SZORDEF3, SRROTA3), the thermal coupling (stherm/visc_et), the 12-component DEF path (SORDEFT12/SROTO12_SIG), the Belytschko hourglass layer, erosion/sms (sdlen_sms), distortion control (szhour_ctl) and the sensor/timer bookkeeping are not.

This is the Belytschko-style stiffness hourglass (GG, FHOUR, NFHOUR, HQ13P/HQ24N, SZSTRAINHG/SZSVM/SZETFAC), and no such routine exists in pyradioss: solid_orthotropic.forces runs the isotropic Flanagan-Belytschko VELOCITY damper from solid_hexa8._post (the shour3.F block, solid_hexa8.py:549-560), which is a different law, and the module docstring declares szhour3_or/szsvm_or/szhour_ctl/gfhour_or/szstrainhg absent.

The orthotropic hourglass law has no counterpart; only its INPUTS are ported and exposed (hourglass_moduli builds CC/CG/G33 via mmodul + gettransv + mstiforthv), and the module says so explicitly - the routine that reads them is not part of the module. Upstream engine/source/elements/solid/solidez/szhour3_or.F is reached only from ../engine/source/elements/solid/solidez/szforc3.F; no caller of that list is a path this port runs.

The ISCTL > 0 distortion-control wrapper is not ported: szforc3.F:911-925 is its only call site, its worker shour_ctl.F90 is only half transcribed (solid_hourglass5._coefficients covers the ladder, not the control body) and its SZSTRAINHG coupling is absent; the port reads an `icontrol` property flag but never dispatches on it.

The HALF/TWO engineering-shear packing around the rotation is missing: SZORDEF3 stores HALF*D4..D6 as tensor shear, rotates with SROTO3V and writes back TWO*DEFN(4..6), while the port's szordef3 is a bare alias of sroto3, so shear components are off by a factor of two unless the caller pre-halves. The routine is also currently unused by the cycle, which takes the JCVT==2 branch nowhere.
Output-only upstream: its only callers are output/h3d/h3d_results/strs_tenscor3.F and output/anim/generate/tensor6.F, and neither the H3D nor the ANIM/VISU backend is ported, so it is unreached.

Output-only upstream: its only callers are output/anim/generate/tensgpstrain.F (ANIM GPS) and output/h3d/h3d_results/h3d_strn_tenscor3.F, both unimplemented, and it needs the STRHG hourglass strain that szhour3/szstrainhg never produce in the port. Unreached.

The STRHG plasticity-coupling accumulator is not ported; its only callers are szhour3.F, szhour3_or.F and szhour_ctl.F, none of which exists in pyradioss, and the module docstring lists szstrainhg.F among the routines deliberately not transcribed.

The SVM1/SVM2 plastic-work scale built from FHOUR is not ported; its only callers are szhour3.F and s6zhourg3.F90, neither of which exists in pyradioss. _isotropic_hourglass_moduli cites szsvm.F in prose only - it supplies the moduli, never the SVM1/SVM2 evaluation.

The orthotropic SVM1/SVM2 built from the CC/CG/G33 triple is not ported; its only callers are szhour3_or.F and s6zhourg3_or.F90, neither ported. hourglass_moduli builds and stores the CC/CG/G33 inputs for it but nothing consumes them.

G1/G2/G3 are produced but the composition G_a = R . E_a with the element local axes E1X..E3Z (and the ISORTH>0 vs ELSE branch that selects it) is absent - the port takes GAMA as already being in element coordinates. material_frame additionally synthesises DIR2 at phi=0 because PropType6 (/PROP/SOL_ORTH) has no `phi` field, and applies none of SORTHDIR3's global-to-element rotation, per-direction normalisation or Dir1/Dir2 orthogonalisation, so any deck with a non-default second direction or IREP/=0 gets a different material frame.
